# SkyRate AI (skyrate.ai)

> AI-powered E-Rate management platform for U.S. schools, libraries, E-Rate
> consultants, and service providers. Built on the full USAC Open Data
> (Socrata) dataset with real-time FRN status monitoring.

## What SkyRate does
- Real-time FRN (Funding Request Number) status tracking with email/push alerts, synced from USAC Open Data.
- Form 470 bid-evaluation co-pilot: compliant, price-as-primary-factor scoring per FCC rules.
- Form 470 lead discovery and competitor SPIN tracking for service providers.
- AI denial analysis: plain-English explanation of USAC denial codes.
- AI appeal generator: drafts appeals citing FCC Order 19-117 and relevant precedent.
- Category 2 budget tracking per BEN, deadline alerts (Form 470/471, PIA, appeal windows).
- Free, ungated tools: FRN tracker (https://skyrate.ai/tools/frn-tracker) and BEN tracker (https://skyrate.ai/tools/ben-tracker).

## Plans (advertised)
- Free Trial: $0, 14-day full access, no credit card.
- Pro (Consultant or Vendor): $499/month or $4,790/year.
- Pro (School/Applicant): $199/month or $1,910/year.
- Enterprise: custom pricing, SSO (SAML/Google/Microsoft), RBAC, dedicated CSM.
